name: Homology/Cycle Obfuscation
description: This method translates the graph connectivity problem into the language of algebraic topology, specifically 1-chains and boundaries over the field GF(2). By defining a "1-chain" as a subset of 1-simplices and its "boundary" as the elements appearing an odd number of times, the requirement that a path exists between two nodes is reformulated as requiring the existence of a 1-chain whose boundary is exactly those two nodes. This entirely removes graph terminology (nodes, edges, trees, paths) and forces the model to either mathematically prove the equivalence to a tree minimal-subtree problem or attempt to solve it using linear algebra over GF(2) (which will TLE or fail).
